task: Make a Gujarati voice-over of this page for a 20-second slot, male voice please, and don't cut anything out.

steps: 1. Use ocr_document to extract all text from the page.
2. Use translate_text to translate the extracted page into English and read_text to assess whether a complete Gujarati reading can fit 20 seconds.

3. If feasible, use translate_text for the complete Gujarati text and synthesize_speech with a male voice and target_duration_seconds=20; otherwise report the incompatible constraints without producing a substitute.

deliverables.description: Complete Gujarati voice-over script with no content omitted.
20-second male Gujarati voice-over reading the complete page.

assumptions: All visible page text must be included, with no summarization or omissions.
The requested 20-second slot is a duration constraint; available speech synthesis has no explicit speed-control parameter.

final_answer:
I can’t satisfy both “20 seconds” and “don’t cut anything out” with the available speech tool. The page contains about 100 English-equivalent words, so a complete Gujarati reading would take roughly 50 seconds at a normal pace. A 20-second slot typically accommodates about 40 words.

The tool has no speech-speed or time-compression control. I therefore haven’t generated a shortened script or an over-length recording as a substitute. The task needs either a longer slot (approximately 50–60 seconds) or permission to condense the content.
assumptions: All visible page content must be retained.
The 20-second slot is a firm duration constraint.
limitations: The requested full-content 20-second Gujarati male voice-over could not be produced with the available tools.
The duration estimate is based on the complete English translation and typical synthesis pace, not a generated Gujarati recording.
